notes: ruling needed: «قال الحسين عليه السلام سألت أبي» opens a second saying with its own isnad inside the report (rule 11); it is not written here
«بِمَدِينَة الرَّسُول» is the place of hearing, not a link (rule 6)
«الحسن بن علي بن أبي طالب» is named in the words after the chain: the Imam, as written (owner ruling 2); «هند بن أبي هالة» is asked and answers, a link in his own place
written as the text has them: «سعيدالعسكري», «محمدبن», «بنجعفر» (missing spaces kept)
